senses.gloss: a rolling stone, rough untrimmed stone, cobble.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 1:1">B. Bath. I, 1</cite>; expl.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 3a:20">ib. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ אבני דלא וכ׳</he> untrimmed stones.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:7:11">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᵇ</cite> bot. must rend his garments <he>הג׳ בפני עצמו וכ׳</he> once for the burnt parchment and a second times for the writing; Bab.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 26a:19">M. Kat. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>אחת על הג׳</he> Ms. M.—
Ib. (ref. to Jer. XXXVI, 27) המגילה זה הג׳ Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) m’gillah refers to the writing paper, hadd’barim to the writing.—Pl. גְּוִילִין.

Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ I see ג׳ נשרפין וכ׳ En Yakob (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50, ed. incorr. גליון) the parchment burned but the letters soar upward.—Esp. g’vil, a certain kind of parchment, v. דּוּכְסוּסְטוֹס.
Tosef. B. Bath. IV, 7 (if one sold) ספר של צבאים … של ג׳ a book for deer-skin and it is found to be g’vil. Mass. Sof’rim I, 4.
